name: 55435 · Edina, MN
findings: ZIP 55435 (Edina) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55435 (Edina) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55435 (Edina) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
